requirements_summary: Throughput & latency: require sustained 400 QPS baseline for chat path, capacity to burst to 600 QPS for 10-15 minute windows; p95 latency target <=120ms for 256-token responses, p99 <300ms preferred. Reserved GPU planning: prefer 8x A100-80GB equivalent reserved (or capacity equivalent on newer Ampere/Blackwell HW) with the ability to add temporary burst nodes. Autoscaling and policies: want deterministic scale-up within 30s for queued requests beyond warm-pool; scale-down cooldown 300s to avoid thrash. Warm pools: keep 2-4 hot GPUs per model variant (quantized + full) to eliminate KV-cache cold penalty. Queueing behavior: max accepted queue length per route 200 requests; overflow strategy: degrade to smaller model (13B) then reject with backpressure. SLA asks: 99.95% uptime, P95 latency SLOs per-route, creditable service credits for missed monthly SLOs. Routing/fallback: per-customer policy to route high-value sessions to low-latency region or dedicated pool. Model preferences: quantized Llama3-70B for accuracy, Llama2-13B for cost-sensitive rerank/summarization. Cost constraints: prefer committed reserved contract with clear overage pricing and burst facility. Compliance: VPC + private control plane, KMS integration, audit logs export to SIEM.
